say:1:1810365001:1.text: Heh, a rare prize has stumbled right into my path.

say:3:1810365003:1.text: Be patient. Surely you don't expect me to carry around all those bottles and vials.
say:3:1810365003:1.source_cn: 别着急。余出门懒得随身携带那么多瓶瓶罐罐。

say:4:1810365004:1.text: But luckily for you, I happen to have the ingredient close at hand.
say:4:1810365004:1.source_cn: 不过你们很幸运，这里刚好有解药的原料。

say:6:1810365005:1.text: With a flick of her wrist, Tephesia conjures a blood-red moth out of thin air.
say:6:1810365005:1.source_cn: 苔佩希转动手腕，一只血红色的飞蛾便凭空出现，上下飞舞。

say:7:1810365006:1.text: The next second, a green beam shatters the moth, reducing it to dust. The crimson particles fall into a vial that appears out of nowhere, mixing with the liquid inside to form a strange potion.
say:7:1810365006:1.source_cn: 下一秒钟，一道青绿色的光束击碎了它，红色的粉末落入一个...

say:9:1810365007:1.text: Here you go. Take the scenic route on your way back. The potion could use a bit more mixing.
say:9:1810365007:1.source_cn: 拿去吧，路上走慢一点，多欣赏欣赏诺珐斯的美景，也正好摇匀。

say:11:1810365008:1.text: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.
say:11:1810365008:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆，管好你的员工，这可不是该对领主说话的语气。
say:11:1810365008:1.male: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.
say:11:1810365008:1.female: Baba Muriel, keep your assistant in line. Such a tone is unbecoming when addressing me.

say:12:1810365009:0.text: One more insolent remark from him, and I'll use his blood to water my garden.
say:12:1810365009:0.male: One more insolent remark from him, and I'll use his blood to water my garden.
say:12:1810365009:0.female: One more insolent remark from her, and I'll use her blood to water my garden.

say:13:1810365010:1.text: T-Thank you for your mercy, Your Ladyship... I'll make sure to teach him some manners once we get back.
say:13:1810365010:1.source_cn: 是、是，感谢您的仁慈……老身回去一定好好管教<male...
